records.title: Argentina approves incentive scheme for $50.8 billion LNG project
records.claim: Argentina LNG project was included in RIGI incentives with staged planned investment $25 billion 2027-2030 and total $50.75 billion through 2050, and an expected export capacity of 12 mtpa.
records.boundary: RIGI approval does not equal FID, funding drawdown, project commissioning or a firm 12mtpa supply delivery.
records.support_excerpt: Reuters original report Nov 20, lines 152-180: RIGI approval announced; planned 2027-30 capital $25bn, 2050 total $50.75bn, 12mtpa.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Argentina approves incentive scheme for $50.8 billion LNG project

records.title: Luis Caputo confirmó que YPF entró al RIGI con un proyecto de US$50.750 millones para exportar GNL
records.claim: Argentine TV news TN separately reports ministerial announcement approving Argentina LNG to RIGI, involving YPF, Eni, XRG and the same investment schedule.
records.boundary: TN page gives 18:26 local clock but does not itself specify timezone; date-only supporting source, not independent exact window anchor.
records.support_excerpt: TN article Nov 20 lines 22-38: government approved RIGI, YPF Eni XRG; $25bn 2027-30, $50.75bn by 2050, 12mtpa.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Luis Caputo confirmó que YPF entró al RIGI con un proyecto de US$50.750 millones para exportar GNL

records.title: Singapore's energy ministry says piped gas supply from Indonesia is fully restored
records.claim: On Nov 20 Singapore ministry confirmed Indonesia fully restored piped natural gas supply on Nov 12 after an 18-day reduction and no further cuts signalled.
records.boundary: Physical restoration happened Nov12; the fresh in-window event is public confirmation on Nov20. Volume units must not be confused: 31mmscfd gross figure and 17bbtud demand impact.
records.support_excerpt: Reuters Nov20 lines 152-166: METI statement Friday; PNG flows restored Nov12; prior cut 31mmscfd, 17bbtud for 18 days, less than 2% of Singapore demand.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Singapore's energy ministry says piped gas supply from Indonesia is fully restored

records.title: Indonesia's piped gas supply to Singapore fully restored on Nov 12: METI
records.claim: CNA independently reports METI saying PNG flows restored Nov12 after October cuts, with domestic-demand diversion and under 2% aggregate demand impact.
records.boundary: Date only for this supporting article; does not claim its own exact UTC publication instant.
records.support_excerpt: CNA Nov20 article lines 294-328: ministry confirmation, 18-day cuts, 31mmscfd reduction and 17bbtud net, under 2% daily demand.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Indonesia's piped gas supply to Singapore fully restored on Nov 12: METI

records.title: More Russian regions limit fuel sales as Ukrainian drone strikes hit refinery output
records.claim: Reuters reports fuel retail rationing in multiple Russian regions including Sevastopol, Tomsk and Penza, with refinery disruptions and supply shortages.
records.boundary: Reports relate to different regions and fuels; 45% national refinery processing fall is attributed to unnamed industry sources and not independently confirmed, so excluded from numeric core claim.
records.support_excerpt: Reuters Nov20 lines 152-181: Nov20 timestamp, fuel sale caps in Sevastopol, Tomsk and Penza, linked to refinery attacks.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: More Russian regions limit fuel sales as Ukrainian drone strikes hit refinery output

records.title: На АЗС «Лукойл» в Астрахани ввели ограничения на продажу бензина
records.claim: Kommersant separately documents Astakhan Lukoil petrol retail sales capped at 40 litres per car; official regional governor office cited.
records.boundary: Astrakhan is a separate corroborating locality, not proof that Reuters figures for other provinces are identical. Site shows 17:45 with no explicit timezone; supporting date only.
records.support_excerpt: Kommersant Nov20 lines 100-110: Astakhan 40 litre petrol cap, regional operational decision and official regional press office.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: На АЗС «Лукойл» в Астрахани ввели ограничения на продажу бензина
